pathway191.subtitle: The 491 is not a permanent visa - it is the vehicle to the 191 Permanent Residence visa. Here is exactly what those 3 years require.
pathway191.body1: The 191 visa is available to 491 visa holders who have met the regional residence and work requirements. It grants permanent residency with no state restriction - once the 191 is granted, you are free to live and work anywhere in Australia.
pathway191.body2: Three things must be satisfied over the 3-year period:

requirements.title: 3 years of residency
requirements.desc: in a designated regional area. You must be physically based in the region - not commuting from Melbourne.

requirements.title: 3 years of work
requirements.desc: in the regional area. Your occupation does not need to match your nominated occupation.

requirements.title: Minimum taxable income
requirements.desc: of approximately $53,900 per year for each of the 3 years. Tax returns are the primary evidence source.

Full permanent residency - live anywhere in Australia
